1. (Currently amended) A method comprising: providing, from a processor, a memory request and a first coherency state value for a coherency granule associated with the memory request; and providing, from the processor, a select one of a first indicator or a second indicator in response to determining whether the first coherency state value represents a cumulative coherency state for a plurality of caches of the processor, the first indicator identifying the first coherency state value as representing a cumulative coherency state and the second indicator identifying the first coherency state value as representing a potentially non-cumulative coherency state; wherein the determining whether the first coherency state value represents a cumulative coherency state comprises snooping at least one cache of the plurality of caches to determine whether the first coherency state value reflects a state across all caches of the plurality of caches.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving, at the processor, a request for the cumulative coherency state for the coherency granule in response to providing the second indicator; determining a second coherency state value for the coherency granule for the processor by snooping each cache of the plurality of caches and providing the second coherency state value from the processor in response to the request, the second coherency state value representing the cumulative coherency state for the coherency granule; and providing, from the processor, the second coherency state value and the first indicator.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining whether to request the cumulative coherency state for the coherency granule in response to receiving the second indicator from the processor, wherein the determining comprises evaluating whether a requesting entity requires knowledge of the cumulative coherency state across all caches of the plurality of caches; and providing an indicator of the request for the cumulative coherency state to the processor in response to determining to request the cumulative coherency state.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6, further comprising: processing the memory transaction without requesting the cumulative coherency state in response to determining not to request the cumulative coherency state, wherein processing comprises proceeding with the memory transaction based on the first coherency state value without obtaining additional coherency information from the plurality of caches.

8. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving, from a processor, a first memory request and a first coherency state value for a first coherency granule associated with the first memory request; receiving, from the processor, a first indicator associated with the first coherency state value, the first indicator identifying the first coherency state value as representing a potentially non-cumulative coherency state of the first coherency granule for a plurality of caches of the processor, wherein the first indicator indicates that the first coherency state value may not reflect a state across all caches of the plurality of caches; determining whether to request a cumulative coherency state for the first coherency granule from the processor in response to receiving the first indicator, wherein the determining comprises evaluating whether the memory request requires knowledge of the cumulative coherency state across all caches; and providing a second indicator to the processor to request the cumulative coherency state for the first coherency granule in response to determining to request the cumulative coherency state for the first coherency granule.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 8, further comprising: processing the first memory request for distribution in response to determining not to request the cumulative coherency state for the first coherency granule, wherein processing comprises proceeding with the memory request based on the first coherency state value without obtaining additional coherency information from the plurality of caches.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 11, further comprising: providing a third indicator to the processor in response to determining not to request the cumulative coherency state for the first coherency granule, the third indicator indicating the cumulative coherency state for the first coherency granule is not to be requested from the processor and that the memory request will be processed based on the first coherency state value.

14. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a first processor coupleable to a transaction management module associated with a plurality of processors, the first processor comprising: a processor core; a plurality of caches; and a coherency management module comprising: a first output configured to provide a memory transaction associated with a coherency granule; a second output configured to provide a first coherency state value for the coherency granule; and a third output configured to provide a first indicator, the first indicator indicating whether the first coherency state value represents a potentially non-cumulative coherency state for the coherency granule for the plurality of caches, wherein the first indicator is determined by the coherency management module based on whether the first coherency state value reflects a state across all caches of the plurality of caches.

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 14, further comprising: a second processor coupled to the transaction management module, the second processor having a shared memory with the first processor; wherein the transaction management module is configured to receive coherency state information from both the first processor and the second processor and to determine whether to request cumulative coherency state information based on the first indicator received from the first processor.
